channel.title: Employee Benefit News - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Employee Benefit News (benefitnews.com)

item.title: Why workers with disabilities still fear taking leave
item.description: Many companies aren't prepared when employees need leave for disability or caregiving, leaving staff feeling unsupported and stressed.

item.title: Why benefits will make or break employee retention in 2026
item.description: When today's job-hugging trend wears off, total rewards packages will be a major factor in workers' decision to stay or leave.

item.title: How off-hours care options help working parents remain present all day
item.description: UrbanSitter and Activity Hero's partnership gives employees a one stop shop for in-home and extra curricular care.

item.title: OE look-back: Advisers reach a cost tipping point in 2026
item.description: Benefit advisers unpack their latest client experiences helping employers respond to a hardening group health insurance market and employee education challenges.

item.title: One setback could derail many Americans' retirement plans
item.description: Despite steady saving in 401(k)s and IRAs, many Americans are one financial setback away from falling short of retirement goals, a new index shows.

item.title: Could office stationery improve workplace well-being? This company says yes
item.description: Merchandise company MOO has added stationary to their suite of employee tools in an effort to boost productivity and wellness.

item.title: 6 ways to combat 'quiet cracking' in the workplace
item.description: Employers can detect and reverse employee disengagement through people and workplace strategies rooted in empathetic listening.

item.title: HR teams struggle with decision-making due to data limitations
item.description: A new report finds HR leaders under growing pressure to align pay and promotion decisions with business goals, but many lack unified data to do so fairly.

item.title: Employees are saving their money. So why are they still stressed?
item.description: Workers are making the right moves with their money, but embedded concern remains and is impacting their work performance.

item.title: The AI skills gap is turning Gen Z into workplace mentors
item.description: Young talent has critical expertise that could keep organizations productive and better prepared for the future.
